product_metadata.title: Umbra Touch Collection, 3 ½ x 3 x 4 inches, White
features: MODERN AND SLEEK TOOTHBRUSH HOLDER: A sleek and modern toothbrush holder for your bathroom, holds multiple toothbrushes and toothpaste

KEEP MULTIPLE TOOTHBRUSHES ORGANIZED: Touch has three compartments; one for bulkier objects like toothpaste, and two smaller compartments, for toothbrushes. These compartments come in handy in shared bathrooms – no more mixing up toothbrushes!
PLAYFUL CIRCULAR SHAPES: Touch is composed of three cylindrical holders fused together to create an eye-catching and modern look. It measures 3 ½ x 3 x 4 inches, taking up minimal counterspace
SOFT-TOUCH FINISH: Drawing on the luxurious and modern look and feel of matte finishes, this toothbrush holder will make a sleek addition to your washroom with its soft-touch finish
TOTAL SATISFACTION OR YOUR MONEY BACK: If you’re not completely satisfied for any reason, contact us within 30 days and we will fix it or issue a full refund
description: Most of us keep our toothbrushes and toothpaste easily accessible, and although what we choose to keep them in might be practical, It's often not so stylish. Upgrade the look of your toothbrush holder/organizer with this modern and attractive piece from Umbra. Introducing the Touch Toothbrush Holder by Umbra Touch Toothbrush holder has three compartments; a large one for bulkier items like toothpaste, and two smaller compartments for regular-sized toothbrushes. Having separated holders will help keep your toothbrushes organized, and you will be less likely to mix up your toothbrush with someone else'sin a shared washroom. Details Touch is made of a matte, soft-touch molded material, which is easy to clean, and highly durable. The finish is both luxurious and pleasing to the eye. Compact, it will take up minimal counterspace, measuring 3 ½ x 3 x 4 inches (8. 9 x 7. 6 x 10. 2 cm). Touch is part of a wider collection of bath products, all designed by Alan Wisniewski, its molded material makes it low-risk for breakage. Other pieces in this collection include a waste can, soap pump, soap dish, and a toilet brush holder. The Touch Collection comes in your choice of white, grey and black. For a neat, eye-catching toothbrush holder that will help keep you organized, order the Touch Toothbrush Holder today. About Umbra: A global product design company providing original, modern, casual, functional, and affordable design for the home.
